description: IO:O (Infrared-Optical: Optical) is the facility wide-field optical CCD camera on the 2.0-meter robotic Liverpool Telescope, equipped with Bessell and SDSS filter sets.
facility_description: The Liverpool Telescope is a 2.0-meter fully robotic telescope operated by Liverpool John Moores University at Roque de los Muchachos Observatory on La Palma.
notes: Filter transmission curves from the IO:O efficiency-model table (Smith & Steele 2017, figshare). The IO:O page lists Sloan u'g'r'i'z', Bessell B and V and H-alpha filters, and says the e2v CCD231-84 replaced the original Fairchild 486 in June 2012. DetectorType photon, DetectorTypeSource inferred (2026-10-26): no owner states the integration convention for the curve file, but these are the filter columns of the IO:O efficiency-model table (doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.4659421), whose Technical Note 1 measures 'the absolute photon efficiency' with each filter 'multiplied by the CCD QE'; the detector is an e2v CCD 231 (https://telescope.livjm.ac.uk/TelInst/Inst/IOO/). The curves therefore integrate as photon counters. The source is 'inferred' because this rests on the published curve content and the documented detector, not on an explicit owner statement.
